_comment: Single source of truth for crisis/helpline details. Read by the Flask backend (app/config.py) and the React frontend (src/lib/support.js). Verified against MoHFW / PIB announcements (Oct 2026). Re-verify at https://telemanas.mohfw.gov.in before deployment.

helpline.name: Tele-MANAS
helpline.full_name: Tele Mental Health Assistance and Networking Across States
helpline.operator: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
helpline.description: Free, confidential, 24x7 mental-health support from trained counsellors, with referral to mental-health professionals where needed.

emergency_services.name: National Emergency Number
emergency_services.description: Call 112 if you or someone else is in immediate danger.

affiliation_disclaimer: MindWell is an independent student project. It is not operated by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Tele-MANAS or the Government of India.
